outline: This course introduces programming planning/design/drafting skills using UML (2.0) standards. Students will learn how to plan, design, draw diagrams before diving into time-consuming programming of their programs or information system. It also introduces how to co-program in a team and how to lead a team of programmers by programming plans, designs, and diagrams by using a unified modeling language (UML).
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Programming
Week 2: Conventional vs. Object-oriented Programming: Overview
Week 3: Conventional vs. Object-oriented Programming Comparison
Week 4: Conventional vs. Object-oriented Programming: Practice (I)
Week 5: Conventional vs. Object-oriented Programming: Practice (II)
Week 6: Introduction to Unified Modeling Language (UML)
Week 7: UML Activity Diagram
Week 8: UML Use Case Diagram
Week 9: Midterm presentations (I)
Week 10: Midterm presentations (II)
Week 11: UML Sequence Diagram
Week 12: UML Class Diagram (I)
Week 13: UML Class Diagram (II)
Week 14: UML Object Diagram (I)
Week 15: UML Object Diagram (II)
Week 16: UML State Machine Diagram
Week 17: Final Presentations (I)
Week 18: Final Presentations (II)
assessment:
Class performance (quiz, activities, discussions): 30% (+/- 10%)
Midterm presentation: 30% (+/- 10%)
Final Projects: 40% (+/- 10%)
